Chocolate Peanut Butter Bar Delight
By: bottomless kitchen
Published: Tuesday, October 12, 2010 - 6:26pm

Ingredients




1 cup of melted butter
2 1/2 cups of graham cracker crumbs
2 3/4 cups of confectioners' sugar
1 cup of peanut butter
2 cups of semisweet chocolate chips

Preparation

1 Mix together the butter, graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and first cup of the peanut butter until well blended. 2 Press evenly into an ungreased 9x13 pan. (We used a pyrex.) 3 Melt the chocolate chips in the microwave. (Or, if you are like us and do not have a microwave...create a double boiler of sorts by placing a metal bowl over simmering water on the stove to melt the chips.) 4 Spread chocolate evenly over peanut butter filling. 5 Refrigerate for at least one hour.  (Until chocolate crust hardens throughout.) 6 Cut into squares, serve, and enjoy!

About


A snippet from bottomlesskitchen.com: "Very quick & easy (especially if you have a microwave...) recipe, as there is no baking or cooking involved with this dessert.  A little mixing and patiently waiting for the squares to harden is all you need!"
